name: robbyant/lingbot-map-v2-base-streaming
title: Robbyant releases LingBot-Map 2.0 inference code and streaming base weights for frame-by-frame 3D reconstruction
summary: A causal streaming model predicts camera pose, intrinsics, depth and confidence as RGB frames arrive, runnable from a CLI or embedded per frame in an app. Code and weights are CC BY-NC 4.0, so noncommercial only.
